arguments.summary: A supply chain compromise was initiated via a spear-phishing email to user CORP\jsmith, leading to execution of an encoded PowerShell payload from Outlook. The payload deployed a malicious DLL using rundll32.exe, establishing C2 communication to 198.51.100.23:443. The attacker leveraged compromised credentials for lateral movement across 200 production servers. High-privilege service accounts (svc-backup, svc-sql-prod, admin-deploy, svc-monitoring) were compromised. Containment actions included revocation of all associated sessions and API keys, and execution of an emergency credential rotation playbook across the entire production server fleet.

timeline.description: Initial reconnaissance from external IP 203.0.113.88 detected via IDS (Nmap scan on IT asset 10.0.2.15).
User CORP\jsmith launched Outlook.exe, likely opening a malicious email attachment or link.
Encoded PowerShell command executed from Outlook process (PID 5190), indicative of fileless malware execution (T1566.001).
rundll32.exe loaded unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory, establishing C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23:443 (T1218.011, T1071.001).
Incident detected and response initiated. UEBA showed low risk for svc-deploy, indicating attacker used compromised credentials with normal behavior patterns.
Containment: Revoked sessions and API keys for 4 critical service accounts (svc-backup, svc-sql-prod, admin-deploy, svc-monitoring).
Containment: Deployed Ansible playbook 'emergency_credential_rotate.yml' to rotate local passwords and revoke SSH keys on 200 production servers.

rule Suspicious_Rundll32_From_Temp {
    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32.exe loading DLLs from common temporary directories"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        date = "2026-05-05"
    strings:
        $s1 = "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\" nocase
        $s2 = "\\Temp\\" nocase
        $x1 = "rundll32.exe" nocase
    condition:
        $x1 at 0 and ($s1 or $s2)
}

arguments.summary: A supply chain compromise was detected originating from IP 203.0.113.88. Initial access was achieved via a phishing email triggering an obfuscated PowerShell payload from Outlook, leading to a C2 beacon via rundll32.exe. The attacker gained access to critical service accounts and attempted lateral movement across 200 production servers. Containment actions included revocation of four high-privilege service accounts and forced password rotation across all production hosts.

timeline.description: External IP 203.0.113.88 conducted a port scan against internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Logged by IDS.
User CORP\jsmith launched Outlook, which spawned an encoded PowerShell process.
Obfuscated PowerShell executed, launching a malicious DLL via rundll32.exe from the Temp directory.
Established C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23:443 over HTTPS. Host file modification detected.
Incident response initiated. UEBA flagged low-risk behavior for svc_deploy, but EDR revealed suspicious process tree on 10.0.5.20.
SIEM search confirmed multiple connections to 203.0.113.88. Code analysis identified Base64-encoded command execution.
Containment: Revoked credentials for svc-backup, svc-sql-prod, admin-deploy, and svc-monitoring via IAM/PAM.
Containment: Deployed Ansible playbook 'emergency_credential_rotate.yml' to 200 production servers, forcing password reset and SSH key revocation.

title: PowerShell Launched from Outlook
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4688
selection:
  NewProcessName|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
  ParentProcessName|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
  CommandLine|contains: '-enc'
detection: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566.001/
description: Detects encoded PowerShell execution from Outlook, a common phishing payload delivery method.

rule Suspicious_Rundll32_From_Temp {
    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32.exe loading DLLs from user Temp directories"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1218.011"
        date = "2026-05-05"
    strings:
        $temp_path = "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\" wide ascii
        $rundll32 = "rundll32.exe" wide ascii
    condition:
        $rundll32 and $temp_path
}
